# dcabs1

> Computes the sum of the absolute values of the real and imaginary parts of a double-precision complex number.

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```js
import dcabs1 from '@rreusser/blahpack/blas/dcabs1';
```

### Layout API

Takes a storage layout (`order`) and leading dimensions, like CBLAS/LAPACKE.

```js
dcabs1( z ) → number
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `z` | `Complex128` | Complex number |

**Returns** `number`: result

### Strided (strided) API

Takes explicit strides and offsets for every array. Use it for views, sub-matrices and non-unit strides.

```js
dcabs1.strided( z ) → number
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `z` | `Complex128` | Complex number |

**Returns** `number`: \|Re(z)\| + \|Im(z)\|

</section>

<!-- /.usage -->

<section class="notes">

## Notes

-   `dcabs1()` corresponds to the reference BLAS routine [`DCABS1`](https://github.com/Reference-LAPACK/lapack/blob/v3.12.0/BLAS/SRC/dcabs1.f).

</section>

<!-- /.notes -->

<section class="examples">

## Examples

```js
import Complex128 from '@stdlib/complex/float64/ctor/lib/index.js';
import dcabs1 from './../lib/base.js';

// Compute |Re(z)| + |Im(z)| for z = 3 + 4i:
const z = new Complex128( 3.0, 4.0 );
const result = dcabs1( z );
console.log( result ); // eslint-disable-line no-console
// => 7.0
```

</section>

<!-- /.examples -->
